description: This file defines a class 'Replace' providing static methods for text replacement and substitution operations within the PhpSpreadsheet library, handling both scalar and array inputs, including error handling and compatibility considerations.

classes.name: Replace
classes.description: Provides static methods for text replacement and substitution, supporting array and scalar inputs, with error handling.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Performs a text replacement starting at a specified position for a given number of characters, supporting array inputs.

methods.name: substitute
methods.description: Replaces occurrences of a substring within text, supporting specific instance replacement and array inputs.

methods.name: executeSubstitution
methods.description: Executes the substitution of the specified occurrence of a substring within text.
